sources.scope: General blood-test education: test description and result interpretation sections; not individual diagnosis.

scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Measures blood urea nitrogen as one part of kidney assessment.
high: Reduced kidney function, dehydration, high protein intake or medicines can increase BUN.
low: Low protein intake, malnutrition or liver disease can decrease BUN.
caveats: Interpret with other kidney measurements. This narrow entry accepts nitrogen mass concentration only; it does not equate urea with BUN or convert between them.
